text:
jon-sre: sa-east1 egress NAT flapping, packet drops ~8% for last 3m. GSLB auto-steer started shifting traffic to na-west/eu-west. Seeing 502s from clients in SA. Anyone on call?

ravi-infra: on it. looks like metal-nat-gw-3 in sa-east1 is rebooting; BGP flaps. we should reduce weight to 0.05 and bump ttl to 30s to speed eviction.

maya-runtime: agree on weight adjust. can we prefill KV caches in na-west for top customer buckets? otherwise PU latency spike when traffic moves.

anna-platform: @ravi @maya check customer affinity -> we have sticky cookies for some enterprise customers, need graceful fallback plan.

jon-sre: temp plan: gslb policy set weights sa-east1=0.05 na-west=0.7 eu-west=0.25, ttl=30. applying now.

deploy-bot: policy-change: gslb/update weights applied by jon-sre. Change ID: pc-8942. Rolling out to global controllers.

ravi-infra: command used:
```bash
gslbctl set-weights --policy=dynamic --set "sa-east1:0.05,na-west:0.7,eu-west:0.25" --ttl=30
```

metrics-bot: Alert: egress-packet-drop(sa-east1) decreased from 8.1% -> 1.2% after change. Request rate to na-west increased by 18%.

maya-runtime: Started KV prefill for customer top-50 with script:
```python
# prefill script
for k in hot_keys: cache.prefill(k, target_region='na-west')
```

sarah-support: Customer ETA: we have two orgs reporting slow writes ~5m ago. Notified both and they're seeing improvement now.

anna-platform: Cost note: na-west spot capacity usage jumped 22%. Recommend monitor for sustained >30% then consider temporary reserved bump or enable burst-capacity.

jon-sre: keeping ttl low to allow quick rebalancing. we'll monitor for 30m and rollback if na-west pressure gets high. assigning @ravi to continue until stable.

ravi-infra: ack. I'll also open a support ticket with cloud provider for NAT gw flaps. ticket #CB-4521. will post updates.

jon-sre: thanks. if NAT gw comes back healthy, we'll ramp sa-east1 back to normal weights incrementally: 0.2 -> 0.5 -> 1.0 with 10m waits.

deploy-bot: ticket-tracker: CB-4521 created by ravi-infra.

maya-runtime: :thumbsup: monitoring KV warmup; latency p99 for redirected sessions at 230ms (was 480ms).

ravi-infra: update: cloud says maintenance on underlying rack, ETA 40m. they'll attempt soft-reboot; we've requested expedited remediation.

jon-sre: good. last check: no customer-facing errors besides the two reported. setting reminder to reassess at +30m. thx all.
